runs.text: A rainy Tuesday in 2019, one umbrella and a bus that never came. Theo offered to share; Amelia offered coffee. Eight years later, we’re still sharing umbrellas.

1:1.text: Met at the No. 23 bus stop in the rain

2:1.text: Moved into our first flat on Rose Street

3:1.text: Adopted Biscuit, the world’s calmest dog

4:1.text: Theo proposed on the cliffs at Sennen Cove
